articles.title: Salesforce Expands Into Defense And Wildfire AI With Long Term Deals
articles.mainIdea: Salesforce Expands Into Defense And Wildfire AI With Long Term Deals
articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Salesforce Expands Into Defense And Wildfire AI With Long Term Deals. Salesforce (NYSE:CRM) secured a US$5.6b, 10 year contract with the U.S. Army to support digital modernization and AI enablement. The company also launched EMBERPOINT LLC, a wildfire response venture with Lockheed Martin, PG&E, and Wells Fargo. Both developments expand Salesforce's role in government technology and public safety infrastructure beyond its core CRM offering. articles.title: Lockheed Martin Secures Missile Deal And Wildfire Venture Fuels Growth Story

articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Lockheed Martin Secures Missile Deal And Wildfire Venture Fuels Growth Story. Lockheed Martin (NYSE:LMT) has secured a seven year framework agreement with the Department of War to quadruple annual production of its THAAD missile interceptors. The same agreement will expand production of PAC-3 missile interceptors over the contract period. Lockheed Martin is also launching the EMBERPOINT wildfire technology venture with partners to address detection and response for large scale fires.
